volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

width.tooltip: Pixels per line. 0 = no raster. 1 = one pixel. Slider 0…512 is a guide only — type larger values if you want.

height.tooltip: Number of lines. 0 = no raster. 1 = one pixel. W×H samples fill one rolling frame. Slider max is a guide only.

lineRate.tooltip: Lines drawn per second. Frame rate = Line Rate / Height. A source at N x Line Rate Hz shows N still cycles per line. Default 3675 Hz = the old 8 px/sample at Width 96, 44.1 kHz.

contrast.tooltip: Compressive color contrast (S-curve on R/G/B). 1 = unity. 0 = mid grey. Above 1 opens midtones and rolls off highlights/shadows instead of clipping.

brightness.tooltip: 1 = unity. 0 = black. Above 1 lifts the face.

hue.tooltip: Rotate processed RGB hue. 0 = unchanged. ±1 = full cycle. Applied after invert/contrast/brightness on the face and analog R/G/B/📺 outs.

blur.tooltip: Gaussian blur of the presented raster (canvas filter). 0 = hard pixels. Higher softens the picture.

glow.tooltip: Additive wider Gaussian bloom of the same raster. Works with or without Blur.

invert.tooltip: 0 = normal. 1 = photographic invert of the whole screen (black plate → white). In between crossfades.

polarity.tooltip: Analog R/G/B/📺 outs after grade. Bipolar (default) = −1…+1 (mid grey = 0). Unipolar = 0…1 video (mid grey = 0.5). Face pixels stay 0…1 either way.

motion.tooltip: Domain motion (What I See Is What I Hear — face + X/Y/Z share one mapping). Scroll: pan a frozen 2D field. Volume: time walks the 3rd lattice axis → morph in place. X/Y/Z are three fixed spatial probe points on that same field.

frequency.tooltip: Domain rate (Hz): scroll speed or volume Z-walk rate. 0 freezes. X/Y/Z are field samples at three fixed points — not white noise.

octaves.tooltip: Layer count. More octaves = finer fractal detail (higher CPU).

lacunarity.tooltip: Frequency multiplier per octave (2 = classic Perlin stack).

scale.tooltip: Spatial frequency of the noise lattice.

zoom.tooltip: View magnification (and domain span for probes).

contrast.tooltip: Dynamics around mid/zero — same law on face and X/Y/Z. 1 = unity. >1 expands (more black/white, hotter CV swings). <1 compresses toward mid-gray / quieter field. Clamps at ±1 after expand.

brightness.tooltip: Overall gain after contrast. Face: scales mono toward black (0 = black plate). X/Y/Z: scales bipolar CV toward silence. 1 = full.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. Bypass = dry. LP / HP use LPF / HPF. BP is HP→LP in series (no cutoff swap — HPF above LPF collapses the band).

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). In BP, raising this past LPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). In BP, lowering this past HPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

frequency.tooltip: Pitch of the comb: delay D = fs/f (fractional). When ƒ is wired, that Hz is the pitch (absolute). Unwired uses this knob (Hz).

decay.tooltip: Feedback only: wall-clock seconds for the loop envelope to fall to 1/e. g = exp(−D/(τ·fs)) with D = fs/f. Hold ≈ undamped. Unused in Feedforward.

hold.tooltip: Feedback only: g ≈ 1 (sustained loop). No loop DC block (keeps Decay accurate). Positive polarity + DC input can accumulate — HP after if needed.

damping.tooltip: Feedback only: one-pole lowpass in the loop (Karplus–Strong style). 0 = bright pure comb, 1 = dark / faster high-partial loss.

topology.tooltip: Feedback = recursive comb (resonates / can sustain). Feedforward = FIR color only (notches/peaks, no self-resonance).

invert.tooltip: + = delayed term added (peaks at k·f). − = subtracted (peaks at odd half-multiples).

depth.tooltip: Feedforward only: amount of delayed input mixed in (0 = dry, 1 = full comb color). Ignored in Feedback.

amplitude.tooltip: Input scale before the comb (impulse / audio / Trigger).

layout.text: The fractal brownian field (fbF) is  getting processed by PixeGrid via brightness and contrast settings.
Did you ever ask yourself what brightness and contrast is in terms of noise? Now you know.

interpolate.tooltip: Glide curve from the previous hold to the new sample: Linear = t, Smoothstep = 3t²-2t³, Quadratic Out = 1-(1-t)² (ends slow), Quadratic In = t² (starts slow), Cosine = (1-cos πt)/2, Hold = jump, no glide. Only active when Smoothing > 0. Applies to Ext and internal Left/Right, internal Sample Freq or external Clock.

smoothing.tooltip: Glide time as a factor of the clock period (1/Sample Freq, or the last Clock interval). 0 = classic hold (instant step at the latch), 1 = glide lasts one period, >1 = never quite arrives before the next latch. Not clamped above.

phaseOffset.tooltip: Delays the Right lane's latch by this fraction of the clock period (0 and 1 = with Left, 0.5 = halfway). Ext and Left always latch on the clock.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar = −1…1 (raw hold / noise). Unipolar = 0…1 on audio outs for MOD into unipolar params (Sweep, Frequency, etc.) without a B2U. Face/waterfall reads Left Raw / Right Raw (bipolar full height; ignores Polarity), same spirit as Amplitude.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale Ext Out (and L/R audio). Face Left Raw / Right Raw always show full hold. 0 = mute, 1 = full. Use instead of an external attenuverter for MOD depth.

seed.tooltip: Internal noise seed (Left/Right lanes). Same Seed = same held values.
